name: Lakewood Center
description: Lakewood Center is a prominent regional shopping mall located in Lakewood, California, serving the South Bay area of Los Angeles County. Originally opened in 1951, this historic shopping destination has undergone multiple renovations and continues to serve as a major retail hub for the surrounding communities. The center features a mix of national retailers, department stores, dining options, and entertainment venues in an enclosed mall format.
demographics: Lakewood Center serves the diverse South Bay Los Angeles community, including the cities of Lakewood, Long Beach, Bellflower, and surrounding areas. The trade area features a mix of middle-class families and young professionals.
summary: Lakewood Center is a historic regional mall in Southern California's South Bay area, offering comprehensive shopping, dining, and entertainment for the diverse Lakewood and Long Beach communities.
